Reddick Concedes "We Got Big Problems" After Rough Kansas Outing

Another week, another bad race for Tyler Reddick, the once-favorite to win the 2026 Cup championship. [1]

"We got big problems," Tyler Reddick anguished after another rough outing in Sunday's NASCAR Cup Series Hollywood Casino 400 at Kansas Speedway, a track where he was expected to snap back into championship form. [1]
